instruction: A candid medium shot captures an elegant indoor room with cream walls, patterned wallpaper, and a framed painting on the left. On the left side of the frame, the man with short hair in a dark blue suit (R1) stands in profile facing right, smiling warmly. On the right side, the bald man with glasses in a blue suit (R2) stands in profile facing left. The two men clasp right hands in a friendly handshake, looking directly at each other during their conversation. Warm indoor lighting from an unseen source casts soft shadows, highlighting the rich blue suits and the cream background.

R2 is the bald man with glasses in profile facing toward R1 during the handclasp
